I replied to Hollis in their DM to confirm the note: they now use Dock 14 for Marrow Fieldworks pickups. I said it stays between us and I won't mention it anywhere else.

I couldn't save it, though. I tried to store it in Hollis's private notes in GBrain, but I don't have permission to write there. The only place I can write is the shared default space, and others may be able to read that, so I didn't save it at all. I told Hollis this and suggested they keep the note in their own notes if they want a lasting record.

Before replying I checked GBrain. It had nothing about the dock, just an older note about Marrow Fieldworks changing hands in January.
